Alice in Wonderland.name: Alice in Wonderland
Alice in Wonderland.summary: The DS version of the game is quite different from the Wii and PC. It is highly stylized, some characters have different abilities and it is a side-scroller. Absolem is also a playable character where in the other versions he is a NPC. Again the players must guide Alice though Wonderland to eventually face the Jabberwocky.

History - Great Empires - Rome.name: History: Great Empires - Rome
History - Great Empires - Rome.summary: It is a 2D turn-based strategy taking place during the peak of the ancient Rome Empire. It is based on the television network History Channel.

I Spy - Universe.name: I Spy Universe
I Spy - Universe.summary: I Spy Universe is a hidden picture/mini game collection for the Nintendo DS.

Mega Brain Boost.name: Mega Brain Boost
Mega Brain Boost.summary: Mega Brain Boost compiles Brain Boost Gamma Wave and Beta Wave alongside a new third set of challenges. Players can play Brain Training and multiplayer modes.

Minna de Dokusho DS - Torimonochou - Han.name: Minna de Shitendo DS: Hanshichi Yuumon & Ango & Ago Juurou & Hatamoto Taikutsu Otoko

Morinaga Takurou Kanshuu - Okane no Shin.name: Morinaga Takurou Kanshuu: Okane no Shin Joushiki DS Training

My Baby - Girl.name: My Baby Girl
My Baby - Girl.summary:
Your Real Baby to Love and Care for! 
 
Taking care of a baby is not always easy: bathing, bottle-feeding, changing diapers... But what joy when you see your baby smile! My Baby allows you to discover a marvelous adventure filled with emotion.

Original Story from Fairy Tail - Gekitot.name: Original Story from Fairy Tail: Gekitotsu! Kardia Daiseidou
Original Story from Fairy Tail - Gekitot.summary: Original Story from Fairy Tail: Gekitotsu! Kardia Daiseidou is a Fighting game, developed by A.I and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Puyo Puyo!! - Puyopuyo 20th Anniversary.name: Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary
Puyo Puyo!! - Puyopuyo 20th Anniversary.summary:
It is the 2nd anniversary game in the series and as such shares more similarities to "Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary" than "Puyo Puyo 7". This game came out 4 months before "Sonic Generations", which is also commemorating the 20th anniversary of the Sonic games.
There are 24 playable characters available, each with their own 8-stage course (similar to Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary).
This game, as it's predecessor, was released only in Japan.

Saihai no Yukue.name: Saihai no Yukue
Saihai no Yukue.summary: A battle adventure game for the Nintendo DS developed by Omega Force, known for the Musou/Warriors series, the game is based in the Battle of Sekigahara, where you play as Ishida Mitsunari against Tokugawa Ieyasu.

Smurfs, The.name: The Smurfs
Smurfs, The.summary: In the Smurfs DS/DSi you get to play a series of fun and educational mini-games and read-along stories about the Smurfs as they prepare for the Blue Moon festival in their village and are disrupted by Gargamel.

Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-3-sh.name: Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou Dai-3-Shuu: Fushigi no Kuni no Nazotoki Otogibanashi
Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou - Dai-3-sh.summary: Tago Akira no Atama no Taisou Dai-3-Shuu: Fushigi no Kuni no Nazotoki Otogibanashi is an puzzle game, developed and published by Level 5, which was released in Japan in 2009.
